caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of a standing person on a rectangular base. The figure has medium brown skin and long black hair, and is wearing a large headdress with five brown and tan feathers. The figure is dressed in a long red robe with gold and white vertical stripes at the bottom, over a knee-length white tunic with scalloped edges and a black and brown horizontal border near the hem. The figure also wears necklaces, and holds a rectangular yellow object in the left hand, with the right hand resting on top of it. The legs are covered with reddish-brown leggings featuring horizontal gold lines, and the feet are in black shoes or moccasins. The background is plain off-white with a faint rectangular border sketched around the figure, and the artist's signature "Henry Grant" is written in the bottom left corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
